text.text: moving potentially life-changing therapies forward with purpose and heart

We are fearless innovators on a mission to deliver functional improvement for individuals, families and communities. We pursue our goals with passion, determination, agility and urgency, recognizing that countless lives depend on our efforts. We are here to forever change lives. We know we will deliver.
Functional improvement for people living with neuromuscular diseases
Thrive through resiliency, transparency, respect, inclusion and honesty
United in purpose, selfless in action
Own the enterprise outcome, deliver with excellence
Think bigger, act bolder, aim higher and never fear failure

We’re looking for colleagues who share this ethos to join Dyne and help shape one of the most innovative and impactful biotech companies. If you’re driven to deliver for people living with neuromuscular diseases; if you put team and mission first; if you embrace bold ideas; if you are committed to accountability and transparency; if you have a drive to make a difference, we’d love to connect.

We are on a mission to deliver functional improvement for individuals, families and communities. The foundation of our efforts is driven by our exceptional team of Dynamos and their dedication to fostering an unparalleled culture. Hear Dynamos share their perspectives on their biotech careers and what makes Dyne a special place to work.

What I find most rewarding about a career in science is that it allows me to actively contribute to solving real-world problems. At Dyne, I’m part of a groundbreaking team finding solutions to rare neuromuscular diseases. I’m proud to utilize my skills here as I nurture my love for continuous learning and intellectual growth.

Working in the lab puts me at the front lines of discovery. The research we do at Dyne is especially fulfilling because I know it is always driven by a commitment to patients. Each day I go into work, I contribute to the development of potentially life-changing therapeutics. Knowing that my work has the power to make a real difference in people’s lives makes my career in science incredibly rewarding!
I love the continuous learning, the search for answers and most importantly the ability to answer challenging questions that can help patients and their families.

To me a career in science is fueled with curiosity leading to innovative discoveries. The most rewarding part is knowing that the research we carry out at Dyne can change lives of people living with neuromuscular diseases by giving advanced treatment that can turn their future filled with possibility.

I am proud to be an Asian American woman in science, using my unique perspective to bring diverse and innovative solutions to clinical trial design. I strive to amplify the voices of patients through data-driven decision-making, particularly in the neuromuscular disease space. While there is still much work to be done by and for women in STEM, I embrace the responsibility and am honored to contribute to that progress.

FORCE for Good Service Day is an annual volunteering event at Dyne. Companywide, Dynamos join together to make a difference at several non-profit organizations in the Greater Boston area. Over the years, Dynamos have helped prepare donations for children impacted by clothing insecurity, participated in efforts to protect our environment, harvested nutritious crops at a nearby farm, prepared delicious meals for people experiencing critical illness and assembled STEAM kits for underserved elementary and middle school students.

Dyne offers our employees a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, which we believe is an important part of supporting the health and well-being of our employees and their families. These include:

Notice on fraudulent job offers and recruitment scams

At Dyne Therapeutics, we are aware of fraudulent recruitment activities by individuals falsely claiming to represent our company. These scams often involve fake job offers requesting personal information or payment in exchange for employment.

Please note that Dyne will never request personal financial details, passwords, or payment as part of the hiring process. Legitimate emails from our recruitment team will only come from an official “@dyne-tx.com” email address.

If you receive an unexpected job offer or suspicious recruitment inquiry, we recommend not engaging, not clicking on any links, and not opening any attachments. If you believe you have been targeted by a recruitment scam, please report it to your local law enforcement.

We are on a mission to deliver functional improvement for people living with genetically driven neuromuscular diseases through targeted therapies enabled by our FORCE™ platform. We have assembled an exceptional team with deep experience in neuromuscular disease, rare disorders, drug development, and manufacturing and commercialization of novel therapeutics. We have also established a scientific advisory board comprised of leading experts in neuromuscular disease drug discovery and development.

Our leadership team brings deep knowledge and extensive experience in the discovery, clinical development and commercialization of treatments for rare genetic diseases and novel therapeutic modalities.
Senior Vice President, Head of Portfolio Strategy & Operations
